published_source: Printed Table 14, column (2) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2022.4326.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. The article numbers its tables differently from the code: the code's Table 12 is the printed Table 14 (FREP Appointments and Directorships); the printed Table 4 is summary statistics. The spec's table field keeps the code numbering. Earlier: Not from the article (no article text in the project). Authors' 'code final.do' Table 12 block re-run in Stata MP 16.1 (reghdfe 5.7.3) on the shipped directorships.dta (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.4326/stata/t9_t12.do, log t9_t12.log); fixest reproduces the coefficient to 7 digits.
table_note: published article numbering (Nov 4 2026); the authors' code and log number this table 12, which earlier records used
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.3987375 (0.0890654), N 7520, equals printed Table 14, column (2) 0.399 (0.089), N 7,520, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
screening_note: ADDED BY REPLICATION AGENT: Table 12 is not listed in the screening record's specs; it meets the protocol rules (binary staggered treatment, director and year FE, no controls, linear).
notes: Table 12 column (2): reghdfe lognum_directorshipspublic FREP if year > 2003 and (acct_role == 1 | markfrep == 1 | prof == 1): directorship rows with an accounting/finance/academic role, FREP regulators, or 'Professor' in the name, absorb(directorid year) cluster(directorid) ('code final.do' lines 868-881). Rows are director x company x year (BoardEx directorships expanded from start to end year; missing end date set to 20aug2021); the outcome log(1 + num_directorshipspublic), with num = _N of the director-year rows, is defined only on quoted-firm board rows and is constant within director-year; several rows per director-year (mean 1.14, max 9), i.e. a repeated panel assigned to a stable unit. FREP = 1 in the years a director serves as a FREP senior executive (hand-coded for 13 directors, lines 806-850); post-tenure years set to missing (dropped), so no switch-offs. Regression sample: 7,520 rows (reghdfe e(sample), 46 singletons dropped). 12 treated directors (Kreis 1476074 absent). First FREP year (directors): 2004:5 (all always-treated: first observed 2004), 2007:1, 2008:1 (always-treated), 2010:1, 2011:1, 2012:1, 2016:1, 2017:1 (always-treated). Cohorts with pre- and post-treatment rows: 2007, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2016 (one director each). Never-treated directors: 99.6% of rows in column 1, 97.0% in column 2.
